key_point: people port DOOM to absurd devices because its code was given away
title: DOOM has been made to run on an ATM, a printer and a pregnancy test.
caption: DOOM has been made to run on an ATM, a printer and a pregnancy test. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #doom #idsoftware #retrogaming

instagram.caption:
DOOM has been made to run on an ATM, a printer and a pregnancy test.

In 1997 id Software gave away the game's code for free, so anyone could put it on anything.

It became a challenge that never ended: calculators, fridges, tractors. The pregnancy test needed a new screen and chip inside, but it played.

What's the strangest thing you've seen DOOM run on?
